reference_invalid.message: Candidate reference is missing, duplicated or inconsistent.

provenance_invalid.message: Source lineage or field pointer cannot be verified.

provenance_coarse.message: Provenance covers the record root without field-level attribution.

mapping_invalid.message: Mapping status, target or snapshot evidence is inconsistent.

mapping_unresolved.message: Required canonical mapping needs owner review.

mapping_unverifiable.message: Canonical mapping cannot be verified with the available catalog contracts.

dimension_unverified.message: Factor dimension semantics require a versioned canonical applicability contract.

temporal_unknown.message: Reference period or validity requires review.

primary_value_missing.message: Primary quantity is not reported as a known value.

primary_component_mismatch.message: Primary quantity differs from its primary component.

negative_value_review.message: Negative primary value requires methodology review; no avoided-emission meaning was inferred.

formula_unverified.message: Formula reference cannot be verified without an owner-provided formula contract.
